question: What is that production cycle called in which at least one factor of production remains constant?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Short-run Production**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The** production cycle in which at least one factor of production remains constant is called the short run. **
 
• The law of returns to a factor explains such a production function
 
• A short-run production function refers to that period of time, in which the installation of new plant and machinery to increase the production level is not possible. 
 
• The **production function can be described as the operational relationship between the inputs and outputs, in the sense that the maximum amount** of finished goods that can be produced with the given factors of production, under a particular state of technical knowledge.
 
• There are two kinds of the production function, short run production function and long run production function.
 
• The short run production function is one in which at least is one factor of production is thought to be fixed in supply, i.e. it cannot be increased or decreased, and the rest of the factors are variable in nature.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Variable long term production**

 
 
• It is a **production process where all inputs are variable, meaning they can be adjusted. **
 
• This allows companies to optimize their production process and maximize output. 
 
 
 
• **Long run production**
 
 
• **​**The **long-run production function shows the most efficient way to produce any level of output. **
 
• The long-run average total cost curve is also the long-run production cost curve. 
 
 
 
• **constant long term production**
 
 
• **​**Constant long-term production **is a situation where a firm's output remains the same over a long period of time.**
 
• This can happen when a firm's production function is such that it experiences constant returns to scale.
